name: Pomodoro Timer
purpose: A focused-work Pomodoro timer: start work and break sessions, track rounds, and keep a history of completed sessions.

entities.name: TimerSettings
relationships: single row; work minutes, short break minutes, long break minutes, rounds before long break

workflows.name: Run a pomodoro
workflows.description: Open the app straight to the timer; pick work or break; start, pause, reset, skip

workflows.name: Auto-record completed sessions
workflows.description: When a countdown reaches zero, save a Session with its kind and duration

workflows.name: View history
workflows.description: See today's focus minutes and a list of recent completed sessions

seed_demo: A few completed work sessions spread over the last two days so history and today's focus-time summary render with data.
